tasks.short: Investigate suspected waste or recycling ordinance violations

steps.what: Read the complaint and establish the waste investigation scope
Inspect the reported site and capture actual waste observations
Interview relevant people and clarify conflicting accounts
Read the relevant ordinance version and assess applicability to the observed facts
Write the factual investigation report from captured evidence

loop.input: Coordinator-captured observations and factual notes with evidence identifiers and the coordinator's source-linked assessment
loop.output: Draft factual chronology with explicit evidence links and unresolved conflicts
loop.check: Coordinator checks attribution, chronology, omissions, uncertainty and ordinance references against the originals in s6
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported statements are removed and manually rewritten in retained time; no automated violation finding or enforcement recommendation
loop.why_not_simpler: A native case template supplies headings but cannot write a coherent factual chronology from varied notes

steps.what: Check factual report meaning, evidence attribution and unresolved contradictions
Save the existing investigation report in the case folder

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} index to reach the current ordinance source, and a bounded loop to draft only the factual chronology from the coordinator's captured evidence. The coordinator retains investigation, applicability assessment, source and meaning checks; no enforcement action or external notice is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing a coherent report from varied evidence is mixed with factual investigation and ordinance interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can assist chronology while native headings reduce one part of source navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving conflicting accounts and judging whether evidence supports the applicable rule.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator observes the site and can question an account before treating it as fact.
tasks.altitude: A little less chronology drafting and source navigation; investigation and enforcement authority stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Evidence attribution and the boundary between observation and allegation

evidence.claim: A bounded draft can organize supplied factual notes, subject to checking against evidence; it cannot establish a waste violation by itself.

assumptions: Boundary is the investigation and its actual internal report used for case review. Formal violation notices, referrals and sanctions require their own actual final approvals and sends, and are not performed or credited here. Shares are unmeasured estimates.

The complaint producer supplies location, reported time and alleged issue. The coordinator captures observation time, location, evidence identifier, observed material and uncertainty in s2. Actual factual notes are captured during s3 as part of the existing interview work, with no automated transcript; writing the composed report is separately s5.

The coordinator selects the ordinance source and version and judges applicability in s4. Native headings remove only one of ten navigation-and-reading hours; nine retain reading, source verification and fallback. The loop receives selected evidence and the human assessment, not a free legal conclusion.

Only three of fifteen report-writing hours are removed. Twelve remain for constructing and correcting the chronology, plus all nine source-and-meaning check hours. Model access to case evidence must be permitted; identifying details not needed for chronology are omitted manually within retained preparation.
Saving the authored report is one fully retained hour, ungated. There is no automatic case closure, enforcement finding or message send.
unknowns: Is the ordinance source already directly indexed?
May the drafting service process the permitted case evidence?
How much composed chronology is newly written?
research_questions: Do checked drafts preserve conflicting accounts and avoid converting allegations into established facts?

already_counted.description: Retained chronology construction, ordinance reading and final semantic verification

incremental.description: Maintain source links and recheck chronology instructions after case-form changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: 1 navigation plus 3 chronology hours removed, less 1 upkeep gives 3. Low: sensitive contradictory evidence must be written entirely by the investigator and the ordinance is already directly linked; keep the existing workflow without deploying the loop or adding upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Implement funded recycling projects and report progress to the sponsor

steps.what: Implement project activities and coordinate the agreed milestones
Monitor progress and capture actual milestone evidence and linked expenditure
Assemble sponsor progress tables from captured project evidence
Write the required progress narrative and explain variances

loop.input: Verified milestone evidence, sponsor headings, actual variances and linked expenditure tables
loop.output: Draft progress narrative with evidence pointers and explicit gaps
loop.check: Coordinator checks meaning, achievement claims, period, expenditure eligibility statements and omissions in s5
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported claims or gaps return to manual rewriting in retained time
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed tables do not explain varied project delays and evidence in prose

steps.what: Reconcile the report to evidence and repair incomplete tables or narrative
Save the checked sponsor report draft
Review and authorize the final sponsor progress submission
Submit the authorized progress report to the sponsoring agency

tasks.design: Configure sponsor tables from actual {PROJECT} evidence and linked {ERP} expenditure, then use a bounded loop for the required narrative in {DOCS}. Keep implementation, monitoring, reconciliation and grant-signatory review intact; the coordinator submits the exact authorized report through {PARTNER_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project evidence and financial references need to be assembled into a sponsor-specific report.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project reporting can assemble existing captured fields, with bounded help for explanatory prose.
tasks.still_hard: Demonstrating real progress and explaining delays without overstating achievement or eligible expenditure.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator knows what actually happened and can challenge a milestone that looks complete only on paper.
tasks.altitude: Less report assembly, with unchanged implementation and accountability to the sponsor.

reach.task: Explain project variance to the sponsor
reach.learn: Grant evidence requirements and budget eligibility boundaries

evidence.claim: Structured project reports can assemble captured milestone tables, while bounded drafting can assist narrative subject to reconciliation and signatory review.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual implementation, evidence capture and the required sponsor report with real external submission. It does not invent project outputs or automate delivery. Shares are provisional; the signatory's eight hours are other-role work excluded from the focal denominator.

The sponsor supplies project identifier, reporting period, required indicators, evidence rules and report headings. The coordinator captures milestone identifier, actual date, status, evidence reference and variance in s2. Finance supplies existing transaction identifier, project code, amount and date through normal expenditure records; no new free finance cleanup is assumed.

The native template copies exact verified fields and totals. It does not decide eligibility or completion. Missing evidence, unmatched financial references and layout failures return to manual repair in the ten retained reconciliation hours. All project monitoring and evidence capture remain counted.

The loop removes six of twenty narrative hours, retaining fourteen for construction and rewriting. The signatory reviews the complete saved version, including attachments, period and destination; revisions invalidate authorization before s8. The real send and ordinary save each retain one hour, and only the real send is gated.
unknowns: Can the sponsor's required tables be represented by native project reporting?
Are evidence and project-coded expenditure already maintained?
Who is the authorized grant signatory?
research_questions: Can assembled tables and checked prose preserve reporting period, evidence sufficiency and actual variance?

already_counted.description: Evidence capture, retained narrative construction and reconciliation including failed table repair

incremental.description: Maintain sponsor field mappings and test narrative instructions when report requirements change

approvals.approved_version: Exact final progress report, evidence attachments, reporting period and sponsor destination authorized in s7; revisions void authorization

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Focal B=92, R=71: gross 22.83 less 3 upkeep gives 19.83. Conservative case: disputed milestone evidence requires all twenty narrative hours manually, but the fifteen exact-table hours remain removable; 100*15/92 minus 3 leaves 13.30.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present public recycling guidance and environmental benefits

steps.what: Select current local recycling guidance and suitable public examples
Assemble repeated slide headings and standard presentation formatting
Write audience-appropriate explanations of recycling practices and benefits

loop.input: Selected current local guidance, public examples and audience level
loop.output: Draft explanations limited to supplied rules and examples
loop.check: Coordinator checks accepted waste streams, caveats, benefit claims, readability and accessibility against the sources in s4
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported claims or unsuitable wording are rewritten manually within retained time
loop.why_not_simpler: A slide master repeats formatting but cannot adapt prose explanations to the audience

steps.what: Check presentation meaning, local rules and accessibility; repair formatting failures
Save the checked presentation
Make the public presentation and demonstrate recycling practices
Answer questions and clarify local sorting uncertainties

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} slide master for repeated layout and a bounded draft for explanations from current selected recycling guidance. The coordinator checks substance and access needs, then presents and answers questions personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated slide layout and initial prose writing can sit inside preparation for a live presentation.
tasks.enabler_now: A reusable master and constrained drafting can handle those preparation elements.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining locally specific sorting rules clearly without overstating environmental benefits.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator notices a misconception and demonstrates the correct practice using the audience's own example.
tasks.altitude: Less presentation assembly; live public explanation and accountability remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain a contamination example to residents
reach.learn: Accessible public language and local acceptance rules

evidence.claim: Native slide masters can remove repeated formatting, while bounded source-based drafting can assist audience explanations subject to human checking.

assumptions: The task includes actual presentation preparation and delivery, not a new public-education report or attendee register. No email distribution or website publication is assumed; the presentation is used in person.

In s1 the coordinator selects current local acceptance rules, effective date, cited benefit statements, approved examples and audience level. This manual source capture remains counted. No invented environmental statistic or unsupported benefit claim is allowed.

The native master removes ten actual repeated layout hours only where slides are assembled manually today. Prose drafting removes three of fifteen writing hours; twelve remain for individualized explanations and correction, plus all ten meaning and accessibility-check hours including failed-layout repair.

The final checked file exists before use. Ordinary saving is one retained ungated hour, and live delivery remains human. All shares are provisional, and material already reused unchanged does not acquire a new drafting baseline.
unknowns: Are presentations already made with a reusable master?
How often is substantive explanatory text newly written?
research_questions: Do checked drafts preserve local exceptions and avoid unsupported environmental claims?

already_counted.description: Source selection, retained prose construction and content or layout repair

incremental.description: Maintain the slide master and source-bounded drafting instructions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: 10 layout plus 3 drafting hours removed less 1 upkeep gives 12. Conservative case: a specialist-access audience requires all fifteen prose hours manually, while the compatible native master still removes ten layout hours; less one upkeep leaves nine.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design community solid and hazardous waste programs

steps.what: Research community waste needs, service evidence and current requirements
Discuss community, operating and hazardous-waste constraints with relevant specialists
Choose program options, service assumptions and safeguards for comparison
Calculate option totals from the chosen quantities and cost assumptions
Write the program proposal from selected options and specialist constraints

loop.input: Selected service options, human-chosen safeguards, specialist constraints and exact option calculations
loop.output: Draft rationale and implementation outline with source links and explicit unresolved requirements
loop.check: Coordinator checks meaning, feasibility, trade-offs and exact consistency with specialist constraints and calculations in s6
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported procedures, compliance assertions or assumptions are removed and rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed proposal outline cannot explain the varied choices and local constraints in prose

steps.what: Check program meaning, feasibility and calculations; repair incomplete draft sections
Save the working program proposal

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} formulas to compare human-selected program assumptions and a bounded {DOCS} draft for the actual proposal. Keep community consultation, hazardous-waste expertise, service choices and feasibility checks human; the draft does not authorize operations or assert compliance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program design combines numerical option assembly and prose with difficult local service choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculations and source-bounded drafting can assist the assembly components without choosing waste-handling methods.
tasks.still_hard: Community trade-offs, specialist hazardous-waste requirements and feasibility under local operating constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator weighs conflicting needs and recognizes when a proposed program cannot be delivered safely.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated calculation and proposal prose, with unchanged program and budget authority.

reach.learn: Option appraisal and specialist safety boundaries

evidence.claim: Native formulas can calculate human-selected option assumptions and a bounded loop can assist proposal prose, without designing hazardous-waste procedures or establishing compliance.

assumptions: This task is designing the actual working program proposal. Budget adoption, contracts, public consultation publication and operating authorization are later distinct actions, not hidden machine commits or credited savings. No new program report is created beyond the proposal already required.

In s1 the coordinator captures evidence source, period, actual quantities and current requirements. Stakeholder and specialist constraints come from real discussion in s2. In s3 the coordinator enters option identifier, service scope, quantities, units, selected cost assumptions and safeguards; no clean option dataset appears free.

The native workbook removes ten repeat arithmetic hours only for compatible chosen assumptions. It does not choose rates or infer safe hazardous-waste handling. Missing units, incompatible options and failed formulas return to manual reconstruction in the nine retained checking hours.

The loop removes five of twenty proposal-writing hours, retaining fifteen for actual construction and correction. It receives the human-selected options and specialist constraints, never invents technical procedures or compliance claims, and is checked for meaning as well as numbers.

Existing service-data production and specialists' normal advisory work are unchanged, without a transferred-work saving. New template maintenance is charged below. Shares are unmeasured; ordinary saving remains one retained ungated hour.
unknowns: Which quantities and cost assumptions can be compared meaningfully?
Is proposal prose sufficiently repetitive to benefit?
research_questions: Does the checked proposal preserve constraints and uncertainty instead of turning assumptions into commitments?

already_counted.description: Evidence capture, option choice, retained prose and feasibility or calculation repair

incremental.description: Maintain option formulas and proposal drafting instructions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: 10 arithmetic plus 5 drafting hours removed less 2 upkeep gives 13. Conservative case: novel hazardous-waste constraints require all twenty proposal hours manually, while compatible option quantities still allow the ten arithmetic hours to be removed; less two upkeep leaves eight.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce factual report and proposal assembly while retaining investigation, implementation, public explanation and program choices.
reach: Help program managers compare evidenced options
Explain observed waste conditions with frontline recycling staff
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator with more attention available for real project delivery and difficult local trade-offs, with unchanged enforcement and spending authority.
